COG.note: The law creates a data protection commission and states nothing on cross-border payments.

facts.fact: Law no. 5-2025 of 29 March 2025 creates the CNPD as an independent administrative authority of 16 members on five-year terms, whose members are yet to be appointed by decree, and the law says it can sanction controllers under the data protection law.

systems.system: Commission nationale pour la protection des données à caractère personnel (CNPD)

facts.fact: Law no. 5-2025 of 29 March 2025, published in the Journal officiel of 10 April 2025, gives the CNPD the power to authorise cross-border transfers of personal data.
